class Solution:
    def partition(self, head: ListNode, x: int) -> ListNode:
        less_dummy = ListNode(0)
        greater_dummy = ListNode(0)
        less, greater = less_dummy, greater_dummy
        cur = head
        while cur:
            if cur.val < x:
                less.next = cur
                less = cur
            else:
                greater.next = cur
                greater = cur
            cur = cur.next
        greater.next = None
        less.next = greater_dummy.next
        return less_dummy.next
